d:
Mehman achanak aa jaen to banaie yah jugar vali sabzi!
Lauki kat chuki thi, dal bhigo chuki thi — mehman aa gae! ek grevi se bana dalin do sabzi.
Dhaba Style Lauki Ke Kofte aur alag swad wali Chana Dal — dono ek gravy se!
dhaba stail kophte — kam besan vala munh-men-ghul-jae sikret
1 grevi se 2 alag svad vali sabzi banane ka jugar
lauki ka pani aur besan reuse karne ki trik
mehman achanak aaen to jhatpat kya banaen
Comment karen — achanak mehman aane par aapka sabse bara jugar kya hai?
